title: Stationary storage battery systems.
officialText:
Stationary storage battery systems, as regulated by Section 608 of the New York City Fire
Code, shall be provided with ventilation in accordance with this chapter and Section 502.4.1 or 502.4.2.
Exception: Lithium-ion batteries shall not require ventilation.
